Convergence Headquarters
AKA: Convergence HQ
Location: Central Manhattan
Building Type: High-Tech Fortified Tower
Resources: Landing Pads, VTOL, Anti-Power Infantry, Crowd Control, Anti-Missie & Anti-Projectile Systems, Surveillance, Hundreds of rooms, Live in Barracks for Personnel, Scientific Facilities, Vaults, Power Suppression Cells, Multipurpose Training Facilities
Summary: One of the most defended places on Earth. The Convergence is more than just a team of Superheroes with like-minded interests, thousands staff Convergence Headquarters, almost every single employee is dirty, monitored and tightly controlled by Blacksite's ever present surveillance. The field forces handle smaller organized crime worldwide, even going as far as being directly called in for foreign wars as Elite units even sometimes by the Heroes themselves. The Convergence represents the heroes collective and are kept at a professional, high standard while operating in public.

The Vault
Location: Central Manhattan Underneath The Convergence HQ
Building Type: Underground Superprison
Summary: Multiple floors underneath the Convergence Headquarters are dedicated to the containment of dangerous criminals, anomalous objects, dangerous technology and more all sectioned off securely from one another, the exit up and out of the underground facility ends in a narrow choke point and by the time escapees reach the exist, Lonestar herself is ready and waiting. Lonestar loves when there's a prison break or a riot, sometimes even letting some free just to challenge them for fun and tease them with futile escape attempts.
The Wings: There are two primary wings to prison areas of the Vault.
Hard Containment; Equipped with many tools, precautions and torture options, designed to suppress and subdue the most dangerous and Lonestar's most hated adversaries.
Soft Containment; Many more luxuries are offered here, usually reserved for those that Lonestar wants to convert whether it's just for The Convergence or for herself. Inmates live very comfortably with more opportunity so long as they're not causing staff trouble and stay on Lonestar's good side.
